description: Frozen direct-boundary baseline for the WebUI internal dependency check, measured before any migration (plan section 7.5). Each entry is one violating file pair. `stage` is the migration stage after which the entry must be deleted; deleting it is enforced because a baseline entry that is no longer violated fails the check.

cycles.reason: Stream frame reduction and stream instrumentation reference each other. The reducer moved out of client/stream.ts to client/projection/stream-state.ts (plan §7.3) but the back edge remains until stage 4 separates the stream lease/loop mechanisms from the projection state.

allowances.reason: Node subprocess entry point. It loads the embedded mcode-tools CLI through a runtime URL because the target is a build artifact: `copyMcodeToolsArtifact` writes it into `dist-webui/server/embedded/`, and it does not exist in the source tree, so a statically resolvable specifier would fail the typecheck and the source checks. The specifier is permanently non-literal, which means static analysis can never verify this edge. Declared permanent rather than stage-scoped: no migration stage removes it. The checker's stale-allowance rule still applies, so if the dynamic load ever disappears this entry must be deleted.
